_about: Hand-checked against mcfrith/tandem-genotypes at 706a6b6a134788afb689e35445c67b4c2ae40666 (untagged in repos.tsv, but this commit is git tag 1.9.2) on 2026-09-29, from README.md, setup.py and the tandem-genotypes script at that commit, the LAST alignment guide the README links to (https://github.com/mcfrith/last-rna/blob/master/last-long-reads.md), api.anaconda.org and the repository's tags.

install.documented: needs Python (R only for tandem-genotypes-plot); download the scripts and run them as-is from any directory, or get tandem-genotypes from Bioconda

published.where: README.md:12-13 (names Bioconda with a link to bioconda.github.io, no install command); https://api.anaconda.org/package/bioconda/tandem-genotypes (1.2.0 to 1.9.2); tag 1.9.2 points at the pinned commit (gh api repos/mcfrith/tandem-genotypes/tags); the repository has no GitHub releases

extra_inputs.what: LAST alignments of the long reads to the genome in MAF format, in last-split order, made from FASTA/FASTQ reads with a LAST index of the genome (lastdb), trained parameters (last-train) and lastal --split

tandem-repeat table: UCSC microsat.txt, simpleRepeat.txt or rmsk.txt, RepeatMasker .out, tantan -f4 output, or chrom/start/end/unit columns; the bundled hg38-disease-tr.txt covers only a few disease repeats
gene annotation for -g (refGene.txt, refFlat.txt or BED)

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: No STRhub dataset fits. The input is LAST MAF alignments made from long reads in FASTA/FASTQ (lastdb, last-train, lastal --split). STRhub has ONT reads only as a minimap2 BAM (no ONT FASTQ, no MAF, no LAST index); its only FASTQ is Illumina ForenSeq amplicons, not long reads. It also has no repeat table in a UCSC or chrom/start/end/unit layout.

notes: repos.tsv (and the snapshot's tree.json) leave the tag empty, but the pinned commit is exactly tag 1.9.2, a lightweight tag without a 'v' prefix. setup.py derives its version from git describe (setup.py:7-17), and Bioconda 1.9.2 matches. The script reads only MAF (usage 'microsat.txt alignments.maf', tandem-genotypes:664,697). The alignment recipe lives outside the repository, in the linked LAST guide. The basic output is per-read copy-number changes. The -o2 variant (README.md:86-94: tandem-genotypes -o2 -g refGene.txt microsat.txt alignments.maf > tg2.txt) adds a crude two-allele prediction, the closest thing to a genotype call. tandem-genotypes-plot, -join and -merge are helpers, not the genotyper. The bundled hg38-disease-tr.txt lists disease-associated repeats (names like ATXN7:SCA7), not forensic CODIS loci. 'script' means copying the scripts and running them as-is; setup.py exists but pip is not documented.
